From the Tawa & the Grill

Signature Dishes

Four names that built the reputation. Everything is cooked fresh over high heat, loaded with green chillies and bold Lahori spice — the true chatkhara taste the Walled City is famous for.

The Legend

Spicy Tawa Chicken

The dish everyone comes for — chicken cooked on a giant sizzling tawa with tomatoes, green chillies and fiery spices until rich, smoky and unforgettable.

Grilled Fresh

Mincemeat Kebabs

Hand-shaped mincemeat kebabs grilled over open flame — juicy inside, nicely charred outside, and best eaten hot with fresh naan and onion.

Walled City Classic

Daal Anda

A true old-Lahore favourite — comforting lentils finished with a sizzling tempering and topped with sliced eggs, green chillies and fresh herbs.

Smoky & Bold

BBQ

Charcoal-kissed BBQ with deep marinade flavour and that unmistakable street-side smokiness — made for sharing late into the night.

Our Story

Since 1996, in the Heart of Old Lahore

Arif Chatkhara House began in 1996, founded by Muhammad Arif Butt at Taxali Gate in Shahi Mohallah — one of the most historic corners of the Walled City of Lahore, near the Badshahi Mosque.

What started as a street-food spot became a landmark in its own right. Food lovers, tourists exploring the old city and locals who have eaten here for years all end up at the same sizzling tawa — drawn by a flavour that has stayed bold, spicy and unmistakably Lahori.
